locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.

locator.section: Proper body and abbreviation only; full formula at RG115c, printed xviii / n23 / PDF24

entries.claim: The proper page supplies the body and Qui tecum abbreviation. The complete comparison joins that body to the exact full conclusion prescribed in RG115c, declared separately.
Prescribes the complete conclusion supplied after the proper-page abbreviation. Its unaccented spelling and list-final semicolon remain explicit in the composite witness.
